selection_rule: Start with lexical unambiguous R and M structural-key pools from the same frozen EAS-to-EAH source transition. Independently shuffle each pool with the declared seed; form fixed-size blocks with the declared retained quota and shuffle each block with that same RNG. Select the CF anchor by that RNG from actual M requests in the first block and derive its Dxx code from the resulting request index. Freeze all three complete key lists and the eligible pools before packing or window evaluation. Never select using artifact IDs, artifact hashes, evidence positions or previous window outcomes.
unchanged_gates: No padding, row/section splitting, background movement, identifier tuning, duplicate exceptions or thresholds changed. Both R endpoints retain their real source identities; exact/near duplicate content is reported separately and is never claimed as new unique capacity. Shared candidate, source-token, near-duplicate, derived-view, exact-band and raw-window gates remain required.
